name: theheist-web
description: The browser port of The Heist: bundles the TeaVM-compiled game with ffmpeg.wasm (for converting the player's own uploaded game files) and the page shell.

scripts.prebuild: mkdir -p public/assets && cp node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.js public/assets/ffmpeg-core-esm.js && cp node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.wasm public/assets/ffmpeg-core-esm.wasm && cp node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/umd/ffmpeg-core.js public/assets/ffmpeg-core.js && cp node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/umd/ffmpeg-core.wasm public/assets/ffmpeg-core.wasm
